purpose: A governed, machine-readable summary of the AltisSports asset, intended as the source from which public-facing surfaces (e.g. the Sohadot asset dossier) are projected. The website presents the asset; it does not become the source of truth.

asset.name: AltisSports
asset.framing: Reference Infrastructure for Spatial Athletic Systems
asset.one_line: A governed knowledge and evidence infrastructure for understanding spatial athletic systems across physical, virtual, distributed, human, machine, and hybrid environments.
asset.thesis: Spatial Sport emerges through disconnected products and practices. AltisSports produces the governed language, evidence structures, reference architecture, and machine-readable objects through which such systems can be described, compared, and governed — not another sports publication.
asset.current_state: Reference architecture and descriptive evidence infrastructure. A frozen conceptual and architectural foundation is published on Zenodo (v0.1). ASR-001 remains an unpublished Working Draft under CITE-HOLD-ASR-001. First-wave invitations have been privately dispatched; there are no reviewers yet.

layers.detail: 20 stratified boundary cases (BC-001–BC-020), v0.3, CC BY 4.0.
10-layer inspection architecture plus cross-layer conditions; not a standard, not a maturity score.
v0.1 — 20 descriptive records derived 1:1 from the corpus; no ranking, scoring, or verdict.
v0.1 — deterministic CLI and static distribution over the Atlas.
69 stable identifiers with per-field claim class, license, temporal status, and falsifiability.
v0.1 Conceptual and Architectural Foundation; version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22015549; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22015548. Does not publish or ratify ASR-001 and does not lift CITE-HOLD-ASR-001.
Candidate normative material (C5, provisional); clause text licensed CC BY 4.0 but held from canonical citability.
Wave RW-001 — four invitations privately dispatched; none accepted; no reviewers. Dispatch is not review, validation, endorsement, or recognition.
Fail-closed CI over corpus, atlas, query surface, citation registry, citation architecture, and operator-review baseline.

identifiers.note: ASR clause identifiers are licensed (CC BY 4.0) but not externally citable while ASR is an unpublished Working Draft (held by CITE-HOLD-ASR-001). Refer to the live registry for exact current state.

atlas.identity_model: ATL-D-NNN are stable derived reference handles; BC-NNN remain the canonical citation identity (ATLAS_CITATION_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_V0.1.md).

review.note: Four first-wave invitations were privately dispatched. None have been accepted; there are no reviewers. Dispatch and acceptance are recorded only after real events. This wave is not described as reviewed, validated, endorsed, or recognized.

licensing.caveat: Licensing grants reuse rights only; it is not publication, ratification, conformance, certification, or citation elevation.

trust_mechanisms: provider claim separated from Altis interpretation
falsifiability references (what would change the judgment)
stable identifiers with a semantic lock
hosted fail-closed validation with negative controls
open_holds: CITE-HOLD-ASR-001 — ASR clauses licensed but held from canonical citability pending publication/public review

frozen_publications.title: AltisSports: Reference Infrastructure for Spatial Sport — Conceptual and Architectural Foundation

audiences.note: Stated as capabilities the infrastructure supports, not as a claim that these parties currently use it.
capabilities: Researchers can inspect evidence and its claim class.
Engineers can resolve structured records by stable identifier.
Journalists can trace each claim to a source and its status.
Analysts can distinguish documented source fact from Altis interpretation.
AI systems can consume versioned, licensed, provenance-rich objects.

not: a product certification or conformance mechanism
a ranking, score, or maturity ladder
a claim of endorsement, adoption, or external recognition
